name: io.github.sailorpepe/undesirables-mcp-server
title: The Undesirables TCG Oracle
description: Conformal-calibrated trading-card market intelligence: 455K+ card prices, risk forecasts with a public 30-day coverage scorecard, card-collateral loan terms, AI grading, slab census, sports forecasts, and a 4,444-soul fantasy league — every prediction merkle-committed on-chain before outcomes exist. Hosted endpoint needs no install or key; the PyPI package runs fully local.
